project_state.name: DraftReviewr
project_state.summary: AI-assisted Korean standard draft document review app. The current implementation is a client-heavy Next.js app that stores configuration and results in browser localStorage and calls OpenAI directly from the browser.
project_state.runtime: Next.js 15.2.4 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/Radix UI.

modules.name: app-shell
modules.summary: Root HTML language is Korean; app metadata names the document review system; Toaster and Vercel Analytics are app-wide.

modules.name: document-review
modules.summary: Home page initializes default data, loads document types and documents, uploads user-selected PDF/DOC/DOCX/TXT files, invokes OpenAI review, persists results locally, and displays markdown results.

modules.name: admin-config
modules.summary: Admin page manages document types, common review items, and type-specific review criteria using localStorage repositories.

modules.name: settings-api-key
modules.summary: Settings page stores an OpenAI API key in localStorage, masks an existing key, and supports replacement and deletion.

modules.name: client-storage
modules.summary: Defines storage repositories and serialized JSON contracts for document types, review items, documents, results, API key, user id, import/export, and first-run defaults.

modules.name: openai-review-client
modules.summary: Extracts DOCX text with mammoth or text via FileReader, submits review prompts to OpenAI Responses API with model gpt-5, parses markdown-like sectioned responses, and returns per-review-item results.

modules.name: export-import
modules.summary: Exports shareable review settings or full personal backups and imports JSON via replace, merge, or full-restore flows.

modules.name: ui-foundation
modules.summary: Reusable shadcn/Radix component wrappers, hooks, and className utilities.

shared_contracts.summary: Human-facing product and setup overview; some implementation details need reconciliation with current code.
Next build/dev/start scripts and dependency set. No test script currently exists.
Initial Korean standard draft document type and common review criteria seed.
Storage repository APIs and import/export serialization contracts.
OpenAI request, file text extraction, response parsing, and API key validation contracts.

integration_points: app/page.tsx initializes default data and connects storage to document UI.
components/documents/document-upload-section.tsx connects File input, review criteria storage, OpenAI review, and review result persistence.
components/export-import-dialog.tsx serializes and restores storage state.
components/settings/api-key-settings.tsx manages the API key consumed by lib/openai-client.ts.
lib/storage/local-storage.ts is the central persistence boundary for all app state.
known_issues: claude.md is stale relative to the current app and still references Supabase/API routes.
README and settings UI say GPT-4o or encrypted API-key storage, while code uses gpt-5 and stores the API key directly in localStorage.
initializeDefaultData fetches /lib/storage/default-data.json; verify first-run default loading at runtime because files under lib are not automatically public static assets.
DocumentUploadSection creates a document before review but does not update it to failed if OpenAI processing throws.
package.json has no test script; AC currently uses build verification only.
